thesis: AFTER-HOURS (17:00 ET) read on Thursday 2026-08-20, positioning for the next trading day (Friday 2026-08-21). The down-trend day held into the close: intraday-tape-lab reads a Trend day (down auction) under Mixed control, VWAP 764.84, gap -0.41%, 79 bars, and SPY closed the session at 762.6 (spot 762.45), still below its VWAP in the 760/765 dealer pocket. Structure first, and the multi-month frame is intact: SPY 762.6 keeps its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked), +1.55% over its 50-day (~750.9) and +7.84% over its 200-day (~707.2), mom126/252 +11.41%/+19.19%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.96, roughly 2% under the highs rather than a break, though swing-structure-lab still qualifies a Double top pattern and reads its own trend regime as unknown. The clean deterioration into the close is breadth: market-heatmap-lab collapsed to 29.37% of 134 (narrow, margin -30.63) on the completed 8/20 bar, down from 64.33% on 8/19 and 55.23% on 8/18, so the advance NARROWED sharply and three-bar persistence above 60% is not merely unmet, the latest completed bar broke below the line. Dealers stayed negative but LESS extreme than the pre-close print: options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (spot 762.45) read signed net GEX -5.28B (shallower than the -6.86B pre-close), the flip 766.85, the call wall 765 and the put wall 760, the front expected move ±3.65 and atmIV 12.92%, so SPY sits below the 765 call wall and below the 766.85 flip in a still-negative but less-amplified pocket. Flow turned MORE put-heavy: options-flow-feed-lab callFraction 0.2522 (call premium $1.413B against put premium $4.19B across 12 tickers, 1940 contracts over the $250k bar), the most-unusual print an AVGO 420 PUT ($46.2M, 8.2x open interest, 1DTE) with a SPY 766 PUT ($223.7M, 138.3x open interest, 0DTE) and an AMD 550 PUT also bid. VIX held a calm 16.01 (band VIX 16.0) and volatility-sizing-lab reads NORMAL (conditional vol 12.2052%, throttle x1.23). The near-term leaders stay soft: SPMO 148.31 is -1.63% below its 50-day (~150.8) while holding +13.24% over its 200-day (~131.0), QQQ 710.93 is -0.3% below its 50-day (~713.1) and XLK 183.1 sits on its 50-day (~182.9). Structure first, tactical noise last: HOLD the intact structural core and the first beta-add tranche while the collapsed breadth keeps the remaining tranches firmly paused, tilt the sector book toward the Leading energy/healthcare (XLE/XLV) and Improving defensives (XLU/XLP) funded from weakening financials (XLF), HOLD (not chase) MSFT, and carry a SMALL overnight tail into Friday, adding on a close that loses the 760 put wall.
